title: Chapter 458
text:
Bang!

Before the mechanical beasts could attack, Herlous suddenly jumped up, and the ground cracked as he flew into the sky.

The white cloak on his shoulders suddenly fluttered, and his energy turned into power. Using some special principle, these two pieces of flexible alloy had the effect of levitating in the air. Herlous also flew up and jumped in the air. He struck with his blade and instantly attacked.

Clang!

The Battleship Slicing Blade slashed onto the arm armor, causing Han Xiao to roll in the air.

This armor can fly too?

Han Xiao steadied himself and narrowed his eyes. A Pugilist who could fly was a completely different threat level.

This kid still had some tricks up his sleeve. If he had not advanced, he might not have been able to beat Herlous in this form.

He was not shocked but overjoyed. The stronger Herlous was, the stronger the mercenary group would be.

"This is …" Under the mechanical suit helmet, Han Xiao smiled. "Interesting!"

…

On the ground, Aroshia, Fu Ding, and the rest looked up at the intense battle in the sky.

"Even Herlous can fly. Looks like our captain has no chance. Any Mechanic who gets close to a Pugilist is basically a dead man," the boss of the Volga clicked his tongue.

"Teacher won't lose!"

Sylvia's palms were sweating as she watched the battle closely.

The two of them were flying in midair. The mechanical beasts on the ground could not do anything, and the cannons could not hit the two of them who were moving at high speed. Herlous' attacks were smooth and seamless, making it impossible for Han Xiao to escape. In her eyes, this scene clearly showed that Han Xiao was at a disadvantage.

However, she had an inexplicable confidence in her teacher.

The boss of the Volga's eyes sparkled. "Do you want to bet? I bet that our captain will lose, and you bet that our captain will win. How about that? "

Sylvia had a conflicted expression. "Teacher said that gambling is a bad habit."

"Bullsh * t, he only said that because he can't win," the boss of the Volga said. "Three hundred Enas. Do you have so little confidence in our captain?"

"Okay, I accept!" Sylvia clenched her teeth.

Hum!

Suddenly, a ring of invisible interference electromagnetic field burst forth from Han Xiao's helmet and spread out. Herlous' mechanical suit's vision suddenly turned black, and he lost his vision for a moment.

Herlous hurriedly opened his helmet and observed with his eyes. Seeing that Han Xiao had not flown far away, he immediately slashed horizontally and chased after Han Xiao.

"You want to run? Have you asked for my blade's permission?! "Herlous laughed.

However, this slash cut Han Xiao in half without any resistance. Herlous was shocked.

The next moment, the two halves of "Han Xiao" trembled like water ripples and disappeared without a trace.

Void Mirror Image!

"What kind of ability is this? Why haven't I seen it before? "Herlous suddenly had a bad feeling.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Han Xiao had already quietly returned to the ground and was directly below Herlous. A new machine had already appeared beneath his feet. It was a huge metal disc that was placed flat on the ground. In the center were three equilateral triangular holes that emitted a faint blue light. They formed an even larger triangle that faced Herlous in midair.

Hum!

Before Herlous could move, a thick translucent blue light beam shot out of the triangular hole and enveloped him. His body was out of control, and he quickly fell. With a loud bang, he was firmly stuck to this machine and could not break free for the time being.

This was a trap-type machine. It was originally an object tractor used by spaceships and was not used for combat at all. It was difficult for it to hit high-speed targets, but if it succeeded, it would be a powerful control method. In his previous life, Han Xiao was the first player to use a spaceship tractor in actual combat.

Han Xiao snapped his fingers, and all the cannons fired at the immobilized Herlous. At the same time, he activated [Overload], [Surging Mechanical Force], and [Mechanical Force Overload] on these cannons, followed by [Gene Liberation].

Even if he only rolled the lowest 2.2 times damage bonus, it was enough to end this battle.

Boom boom boom!

The cannon fire created a thick fog that completely covered Herlous' figure.

"Stop stop stop! I admit defeat! Stop fighting, my armor is about to explode! "

Herlous' anxious begging could be heard from the thick smoke. Han Xiao casually walked to the side, controlled the cannons to cease fire, and turned off the tractor.

Herlous crawled up with his face covered in dust. His exquisite Shattering Light armor was now charred and cracked all over. He was in a sorry state, which made his heart ache.

He originally had the upper hand, but he did not expect to be hit with a flaw and lose instantly. When did Black Star become so strong? I can't beat him even with Shattering Light armor. Not only did the gap not shrink, but it grew even bigger!

He thought that he could win this round and wash away his shame, so he felt even more depressed.

"How much strength did you use just now?"

"Not at full strength anyway. Are you angry?" Han Xiao laughed. Because the weakness of the Mechanic class was being attacked in the face, he was the least afraid of being attacked in the face. In his previous life, he had played the Mechanic class for so many years, and the number of people who could attack in the face could be piled up into a small mountain.

Do you really want to kill me, a Mechanic with 27,000 HP and a full set of mecha armor?

He looked as steady as an old dog, but in reality … he was still as steady as an old dog.

However, although he had won, Han Xiao still noticed some problems. This set of skills seemed a little weak against opponents of the same level. It had to be combined with explosive skills to win in one round.

There's no problem with the tactical thinking. Looks like I need to build some stronger machines.

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Herlous was still clenching his teeth. He was used to fighting head-on, but fighting with Han Xiao felt like he was being restrained. He felt uncomfortable all over. It seemed like he had the upper hand all the time, but it was more like he was being led by the nose. The battle seemed very intense, but only he knew how good Han Xiao was at dodging. He barely managed to land a few hits.

Herlous could not use his strong Pugilist skills, so he could not fight to his heart's content at all.

"Alright, stop struggling. It's not the first time you've lost to me. Take off your clothes. I'll fix it for you."

Han Xiao patted Herlous on the shoulder and comforted him.

The two of them were taking off their armor. On the other side, Sylvia's face was red with excitement. She could not wait to stretch out her hand, giggled, and said, "300 Enas. You have to accept your loss."

"My hard-earned money!" The eldest Volga brother howled in grief and pounded his chest.

I shouldn't have trusted that Old Plum!

…

After leaving Planet Sunil, the spaceship took off. In the machinery modification room on the spaceship, Han Xiao fixed Shattered Light. This time, he had fulfilled the prerequisite knowledge and obtained the Commander Grade armor blueprint after paying a sum of experience.

This was a set of armor specifically for Supers. Its attributes were even stronger, and it could even increase energy. Other than the lack of functions, its performance was not much worse than his Amphiptere. However, in comparison, the materials were much cheaper, and the cost of mass production was even lower.

Han Xiao had already gathered the three sets of armor of the Sunil System — Enlistee, NCO, and Commander Grade. This set could be sold to the players step by step. It could basically be considered the first set of faction specialties. After all, Sunil would not sell their top-grade armor. They had to complete missions to gain faction favorability, unlike him, who could directly exchange for it with money.

The other party wanted liver, while he wanted money. The difference between them was obvious. Spending money could save time, and time was priceless. This way, was it not using sinful money to exchange for priceless time?

What a huge profit!

Noriose was very far away, located at the edge of the Shattered Star Ring. It was like one of the gates into the Shattered Star Ring. Even with all kinds of stargates, spaceships would still need to travel for many days to reach it.

This ample time was enough for him to build stronger new machinery and strengthen his combat system.

Furthermore, he also had time to think about what he should prepare for the upcoming Version 2.0 during the version update period.

Now, the problem of Promotion had been perfectly solved. This made Han Xiao heave a huge sigh of relief. It was much earlier than he had expected, which meant that he had saved a lot of time.

After completing this mission with Ames, it was time for him to officially start the early stages of the plan.
